name: two_episode_reference_ablation_20261025
selection: A large object and a small grasped object; selected before policy training outcomes.
learner: Same model_based learner in all eight runs; no additional SAC-only sweep.
original_definition: Our contact-aware retargeting before trajectory correction, not NVIDIA's retargeter.
controls: One paired seed (0), same controller/physics/reward/training settings and contact guidance. Independent initialization. No Tier 1 to Tier 2 transfer.
comparison: 2 episodes x 2 tiers x 2 reference variants x 1 learner x 1 seed = 8 runs. This isolates the reference correction; it is not a direct CHORD performance comparison.
report: Object-trajectory score and fall rate versus transitions and measured GPU time. Include offline correction cost. Keep failures within budget in the report. One seed is a pilot, not a statistical significance claim.
